description: Agent-based, networked diffusion model of mask adoption with social influence, policy mandates/enforcement, media information dynamics, household sharing, market supply constraints, and optional disease feedback.

parameters.mask_requirement: False initially; set by policy after mandate_day

modules.name: PopulationInitializer
modules.description: Create agents, households, retailers, locations, and government/media with attribute distributions and initial states.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day == 0:
  sample Person attributes from parameterized distributions
  group persons into households by household_size_distribution
  initialize mask stocks and shared stocks
  create retailers and set inventory/price/rationing
  create locations with capacities/type mix and base enforcement
  initialize government agency and media channels
else:
  no-op
notes: Runs at t=0; subsequent days no changes.
Sets baseline distributions for latent traits.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Build the person-to-person small-world social network for social influence and information flow.

notes: Default network: Watts-Strogatz small-world as per task.
Network remains static; dynamic rewiring can be added if needed.

modules.name: InformationAndMedia
modules.description: Broadcast media and campaign messages; update individuals’ risk perception, trust, and misinformation belief.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each media channel m:
  effective_message = m.campaign_uplift * government.campaign_intensity * government.information_quality
  misinformation_push = m.misinformation_rate * abs(m.bias)
for each person i:
  trust_delta = trust_update_rate * (government.information_quality * i.trust_in_authority - misinformation_push * i.info_openness)
  i.trust_in_authority = clip(i.trust_in_authority + trust_delta, 0,1)
  risk_signal = effective_message * i.trust_in_authority - misinformation_push * i.info_openness
  i.risk_perception = clip(i.risk_perception + risk_update_rate_from_info * risk_signal, 0,1)
  i.misinformation_belief_level = clip(i.misinformation_belief_level + 0.5 * misinformation_push * (1 - i.trust_in_authority), 0,1)
notes: Media bias interacts with info openness and trust.
Campaign effects scale with government campaign intensity and information quality.

modules.name: PolicyAndEnforcement
modules.description: Issue mandates, set mask requirements on locations, allocate enforcement, and apply warnings/fines to non-compliant individuals.

notes: Mandate triggers location requirements and enforcement scaling.
Warnings have smaller deterrence than fines via enforcement_deterrence_strength.

modules.name: MovementAndLocations
modules.description: Simulate daily visits, occupancy, immediate in-location compliance, and observational norms.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each location: reset occupancy counters
for each person i:
  if rand() < movement_rate:
    n_visits ~ Poisson(visits_per_day_mean)
    for v in 1..n_visits:
      choose location type by location_type_mix; sample a location with available capacity
      i_instant_wear = i.adoption_state OR (location.mask_requirement AND rand() < immediate_compliance_sensitivity * (location.enforcement_level + i.compliance_propensity))
      record i_instant_wear in location stats; increment occupancy
      add i to contact pool for location
      observe in-location mask fraction; update i.conformity_bias via small step toward observed norm
compute signal.location_compliance_by_type = mean(mask_wearing among visitors per type)
compute signal.contacts_daily for use by disease module
notes: Immediate compliance can differ from baseline adoption state.
Observational norms adjust conformity_bias slightly toward local observed behavior.

modules.name: RetailMarket
modules.description: Mask purchasing, inventory restocking, pricing, and rationing constraints.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each retailer r:
  restock_amount = r.daily_restock_rate * population_size * initial_inventory_per_capita / retailer_count
  if day == supply_shock_day: restock_amount *= supply_shock_multiplier
  r.inventory_level += restock_amount
  update r.price_per_mask if dynamic pricing: price += -(price_elasticity) * (inventory_target - inventory_level)
stockout_today = False
for each person i:
  if i.mask_ownership_count < purchase_trigger_threshold:
    demand_base = (i.risk_perception * (1 - i.misinformation_belief_level)) * (1 + i.habit_strength)
    price_factor = max(0, 1 + price_elasticity * average_retail_price)
    will_buy = rand() < min(1, demand_base * price_factor)
    if will_buy:
      choose retailer with highest inventory
      purch_limit = (rationing_policy == 'per_visit_limit') ? max_masks_per_customer : 9999
      purch_qty = min(purch_limit, round(mask_use_lifetime_days_mean * 0.8))
      qty = min(purch_qty, retailer.inventory_level)
      if qty > 0:
        i.mask_ownership_count += qty; retailer.inventory_level -= qty; record purchase
      else:
        stockout_today = True
emit signal.purchases_daily and stockout_flag_daily=stockout_today
notes: Demand increases with risk perception and habit; decreases with price via elasticity.
Rationing caps per-visit purchases if enabled.

modules.name: HouseholdSharing
modules.description: Enable intra-household influence and mask sharing when stock is scarce.

notes: Household norms nudge compliance propensity.
Sharing reduces inequality of access under scarcity.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceAndAdoption
modules.description: Combine social proof, perceived risk, policy pressure, comfort costs, habit and fatigue to decide daily mask wearing; update habit/fatigue and de-adoption.

update_rule.pseudocode:
de_adopts=0
for each person i:
  peers = i.network_neighbors
  peer_mask_rate = mean(neighbor.adoption_state over peers during last peer_observation_window_days) if history available else mean(current)
  norm_signal = i.conformity_bias * peer_mask_rate
  risk_signal = i.risk_perception * (1 - i.misinformation_belief_level)
  policy_signal = min(1, i.compliance_propensity)  # strengthened when fines occur
  utility = w_s * norm_signal + w_r * risk_signal + w_p * policy_signal - comfort_cost * (1 - i.habit_strength) - i.fatigue_level
  if i.mask_ownership_count == 0: utility -= 2.0  # strong penalty if no masks available
  p_wear = sigmoid(utility)
  wore_today = rand() < p_wear
  if wore_today and i.mask_ownership_count > 0:
    i.adoption_state = 1
    i.habit_strength = clip(i.habit_strength + habit_formation_rate * (1 - i.habit_strength), 0,1)
    i.fatigue_level = clip(i.fatigue_level + fatigue_increment_per_day_worn, 0,1)
  else:
    i.adoption_state = 0
    i.habit_strength = clip(i.habit_strength * (1 - habit_decay_rate), 0,1)
    i.fatigue_level = clip(i.fatigue_level * (1 - fatigue_recovery_rate), 0,1)
  if previous_day_adopted and i.adoption_state == 0 and rand() < de_adoption_probability:
    de_adopts += 1
  # mask consumption (wear-out)
  if wore_today: decrement lifetime of one mask; if mask lifetime exhausted then mask_ownership_count -= 1
emit mean adoption as signal.adoption_state_daily and count de_adopts
notes: Utility-based adoption with logistic choice.
Supply constraints limit wearing even if utility is high.
Habit formation and fatigue introduce persistence and decay.

modules.name: DiseaseDynamicsOptional
modules.description: Optional SIR-like disease dynamics with mask-modified transmission and feedback to risk perception.

notes: Simple SIR on contact network proxy (location-based contacts).
Risk perception increases with observed cases.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregate daily observables and compute derived signals for metrics.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate_daily = mean(person.adoption_state)
de_adoption_rate_daily = signal.de_adoptions_daily / population_size
location_compliance_* = signal.location_compliance_by_type[Type]
stockout_days_cum += 1 if signal.stockout_flag_daily else 0
purchases_per_capita_cum += signal.purchases_daily / population_size
policy_cost_daily = signal.fines_issued_daily * 1.0 + campaign_intensity  # unit cost
policy_cost_cum += policy_cost_daily
adoption_by_income_quintile_daily = group_mean(adoption_state by income quintile)
cases_daily_optional = signal.cases_daily
cases_cum_optional += signal.cases_daily
notes: Policy cost counts fines issued plus daily campaign cost in normalized units.
Income quintiles computed from static income distribution.

algorithms.UtilityBasedAdoption: Logistic choice over utility combining social, risk, policy, comfort, habit, fatigue; respects inventory constraints.
algorithms.DeGrootSocialUpdate: Belief update toward neighbor average (peer_mask_rate) over rolling window.
algorithms.LocationVisitSampler: Poisson visits with categorical destination choice and capacity constraints.
algorithms.RetailDemandWithElasticity: Purchase probability scales with risk and habit; price elasticity modifies demand; rationing enforces caps.
algorithms.EnforcementAllocation: Allocate checks proportional to occupancy; apply warnings/fines stochastically.
algorithms.SIR_Optional: Contact-based infection with mask-modified transmission; daily recovery; risk feedback from cases.
